review:
Keepers of the Secret is a 20-line Aztec slot with an atmospheric soundtrack of drums and chanting. Its signature is the Jaguar feature: each time the jaguar lands, it replaces three random symbols with multiplier wilds, or increases the multiplier if the symbol it hits is already wild.

Three scatters award 12 free spins in which every wild becomes sticky, so the jaguar's wilds build up across the round. A bonus buy is available where permitted. BGaming rates it high volatility with a 10,000x maximum, and the RTP is 97.02%. The Jaguar feature makes base-game spins less predictable than a typical line slot.
pros: Excellent 97.02% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
